description: Classifies every Prisma migration under apps/api/prisma/migrations as either 'safe' (additive, backward compatible while old and new API pods run side by side) or 'breaking' (removes/renames/narrows something the currently-running old pods still depend on). See docs/zero-downtime-migrations.md for the rules and the deploy sequencing that reads this file.
rules: Every migration folder under apps/api/prisma/migrations MUST have an entry here before it can be deployed. scripts/migrate-classify.js fails closed if an entry is missing.
'breaking' migrations are applied by the post-deploy Job only, after old pods are fully drained.

At most one 'breaking' migration may be pending (not yet applied to the target database) at a time, and it must be the most recent pending migration. Split any change that would violate this into a safe expand step now and a breaking contract step in a later release.
Every 'breaking' migration MUST ship a down.sql in the same folder that reverses it, used by scripts/migrate-rollback.sh.
